sentence: Before this evolution in transport becomes a revolution, we must understand how self-driving cars work.
translation: 在这场交通的演进变成一场革命之前，我们必须先弄懂自动驾驶汽车的工作原理。
analysis: evolution → revolution 的词形递进游戏：一个字母之差（e→r），渐变与剧变的分野——标题级 wordplay | Before 时间从句设置认知前提：先懂再变 | how self-driving cars work：how 宾语从句（陈述语序）| self-driving 复合形容词（self- 前缀家族：self-confident/self-sufficient）| 科技说明文的“求知先行”立场句：技术狂飙前的冷静一问
pattern: Before this evolution in ... becomes a revolution, S + must understand + how ...
imitationCn: 在这场学习方式的演进变成一场革命之前，我们必须先弄懂 AI 家教是如何批改作业的。
imitationHint: Before this evolution in learning becomes a revolution, → we must understand how AI tutors grade our homework
imitationAnswer: Before this evolution in learning becomes a revolution, we must understand how AI tutors grade our homework.

sentence: Since it is impossible to foresee every situation ahead of time, the system must learn to adapt.
translation: 既然不可能预见每一种路况，系统就必须学会自我调整。
analysis: Since 原因从句（已知事实作理由）+ it 形式主语（真主语 to foresee...）| foresee 预见（fore- 前缀：forecast/foretell）| ahead of time 提前 | learn to adapt 学会适应——把“机器学习”的本质说成一句人话：路况穷举不可能，唯有自适应 | 自动驾驶原理的逻辑枢纽句：从“规则驱动”转向“学习驱动”的理由陈述——议论文因果推理的干净示范
pattern: Since it is impossible to + V ..., S + must learn to + V
imitationCn: 既然不可能预料考场上的每一种题型，我们就必须学会迁移方法。
imitationHint: Since it is impossible to foresee every question type in the exam, → we must learn to transfer our methods
imitationAnswer: Since it is impossible to foresee every question type in the exam, we must learn to transfer our methods.

sentence: The moral dilemma of how to ethically program self-driving cars has yet to be resolved.
translation: 如何合乎伦理地为自动驾驶汽车编程——这一道德困境至今仍未解决。
analysis: has yet to be resolved：have yet to do“尚待、还没有”（= has not been resolved yet 的紧凑版，带“迟早要面对”的意味）+ 被动不定式 | of how to ethically program...：疑问词+不定式作 of 宾语，ethically 副词插入不定式（分裂不定式）| moral dilemma 道德两难（电车难题：撞谁？）| 主语长、谓语短的“悬而未决”句——科技伦理讨论的收束句式（呼应选必二 U4 的 AI 伦理之问，跨书同题）
pattern: The moral dilemma of how to + adv. + V ... has yet to be + V-ed
imitationCn: 如何公平地分配训练数据——这一技术难题至今仍未解决。
imitationHint: The technical problem of how to fairly distribute training data → has yet to be resolved（has yet to be done）
imitationAnswer: The technical problem of how to fairly distribute training data has yet to be resolved.
